instructions: A free template for a calm morning check-in: no streaks, no guilt. Each morning your AI assistant sends one screen in chat: your one next step toward your goal (smaller on packed days if you connect your calendar), today's calendar and yesterday's win. It works on your phone or an older tablet. It only remembers what you tell it, and you can ask it to forget your goal, settings and log at any time.
